title: OECD Economic Surveys: Romania 2026, Enhancing resilience to climate risks
organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
temporal_coverage: National heat-stress data through 2024; disaster records 1980–2023; flood-plan implementation status and adaptation discussion in the 2026 survey.
methodology: OECD survey synthesizes climate indicators, national records and cited sectoral studies.
limitations: Loss and exposure estimates are national or basin-scale; the report does not evaluate each local project.

title: Assessment of progress on climate adaptation in the individual Member States according to the European Climate Law
temporal_coverage: Assessment of Romania's adaptation reports for 2021 and 2023; covers reported projections, institutions and municipal initiatives.
methodology: Commission assessed Romania's 2021 and 2023 EU Climate Law adaptation submissions.
limitations: Implementation and impact detail are often unavailable.

title: UCPM Peer Review Report: Romania 2023
organization: European Commission, Union Civil Protection Mechanism Peer Review Programme
temporal_coverage: Disaster-risk-management peer review conducted in 2023; country-profile annex includes indicators based on 2015–2022 data and mid-century scenarios.
methodology: EU civil-protection peer review drew on Romanian authorities and stakeholder consultations and includes a country-profile annex.
limitations: The annex compiles external risk indices; its conflict projection does not identify a mechanism or model details.

title: România și-ar putea îmbunătăți substanțial nivelul de trai concomitent cu decarbonizarea economiei până în 2050: raportul Grupului Banca Mondială
temporal_coverage: World Bank summary of its October 2023 Romania Country Climate and Development Report and selected recommendations.
methodology: World Bank press release summarizes findings and recommendations from its 2023 Romania CCDR.
limitations: Press release is a summary; the detailed report PDF was not accessible.

title: Romania, EU Mission on Adaptation to Climate Change portal
organization: European Commission, Directorate-General for Climate Action
temporal_coverage: Portal counts and funding displayed in June 2026; localized mountain-meadow adaptation example in Râu Sadului and Cristian.
methodology: EU Mission portal lists Romanian adaptation participants, funding and example projects.
limitations: Portal stories are selected examples, not impact evaluations.
